thread:
maria: noticing a weird spike in the streams console for tenant `acme-corp` — reconnects jumped ~300 in 2m and billing shows extra resume_charges. suspect duplicate resume acceptance during route flip :eyes:
kevin: can you grab the console link + exact time range?
maria: https://console.redwood/streams/graphs?range=2024-07-22T09:10-09:12 spike at ~09:11. logs show client retried with same resume-id then origin 502 then 200 after route swap
sam: extracted a few lines from proxy logs around the window:
```
[09:11:02] INFO resume_attempt id=abc123 route=us-east-1 -> us-west-2 status=retry
[09:11:03] WARN resume_conflict id=abc123 duplicate=1 accepted_by=instance-7
[09:11:04] INFO resume_attempt id=abc123 route=us-west-2 status=accepted accepted_by=instance-12
[09:11:05] INFO resume_success id=abc123 token=tok-zzz
```
jess: sticky routing enabled for most tenants, but `acme-corp` was on latency-with-fallback policy (sticky=false). route bounce + short keepalive could cause two different backends to accept the same resume flow
maria: net: client drops connection -> edge proxy reconnects -> routing policy picks fallback region -> both old backend and new backend accept same resume id before dedupe replicates
kevin: our current resume dedupe TTL is 10s and sits in the backend instance only. edge keepalive is 15s so proxy can open new connection to new backend while old backend still thinks session live. that explains double billing.
sam: telemetry: `stream.reconnects` +230 at 09:11, `stream.resume_confirmed` shows two distinct backend increments, billing metric `billing.resume_charges` increased by 2x for same client id
maria: options: 1) increase dedupe window and make it global (shared store) 2) make proxies forward last-accepted resume token when rewiring 3) tweak routing to prefer sticky bind for resume flows
jess: UX ask: console should surface mismatch between resume_charges and resume_confirmed (per-resume-id) and alert when ratio > 1.5. ops would catch quicker
kevin: short-term patch: add a proxy debug flag to log `X-Resume-Id` + `backend-instance` on accept and ship for 24h to canary region (us-west-2). add a small debounce at proxy to wait 200ms for dedupe note from previous backend before accepting duplicate
maria: longer-term: implement a lightweight global resume lease in routing layer (redis/hot kv) with 30s TTL so any accept is visible to others
sam: agree. also need a billing-side dedupe for 10s grace window so we don't double-charge until infra fully rolled out
jess: will add console alert and a dashboard panel showing per-tenant resume-id duplication rate + link to thread
deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled for us-west-2 at 2024-07-22T11:00 :robot_face:
maria: I'll open a GH issue with proposed plan and link logs + console screenshots. tagging eng-platform + eng-runtime. sound good? :+1:
kevin: yep, create ticket and tag `eng-platform` and `eng-runtime`. small canary first, then metrics check
maria: created https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/2345 — summary + proposed short/long fixes + log snippets. leaving action items there.
